summary: Iteration 3 re-test of v2.0 deltas after fixes. ALL three iteration_2 issues are resolved: (1) Backend pytest 21/21 PASS — added test_canon_html_404_for_unknown, updated test_canon_html_page + test_canon_html_403_for_non_canon to hit /api/canon/{id}/page, repurposed test_safety_blocks_marketplace → test_safety_blocks_approve which asserts 400 + 'Safety engine' + 'cannot canonize' in detail. (2) Control Deck Engine Health tile renders '26/26' (visually confirmed via screenshot). (3) PublicCanon 'Open server page' button data-testid='public-open-server-page' targets https://<host>/api/canon/{id}/page; the URL returns 200 text/html with og:image, og:url, og:title, twitter:card meta tags (confirmed by curl + grep).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py still ~1320 lines — recommend split into routers/{pmos,canon,marketplace,webhooks,auth}.py after Day-1.

Two HTML route registrations (legacy @app.get('/canon/{asset_id}') + production @api.get('/canon/{asset_id}/page')) both call _render_public_canon_html — fine, but document the legacy alias is intentionally backend-only (ingress doesn't expose it). Consider removing legacy alias once nothing references it.
SAFETY_BLOCKLIST is still a hard-coded tuple in server.py — move to a config collection so admins can update at runtime without redeploy.
Pillow render_og can still raise if font assets unavailable — wrap to return placeholder PNG instead of 500.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py (updated 3 tests to use /api/canon/{id}/page; added test_canon_html_404_for_unknown; renamed test_safety_blocks_marketplace → test_safety_blocks_approve to assert 400 + safety detail)

success_rate.frontend: 100% on the three delta surfaces (Control Deck 26/26, PublicCanon button href, /api/canon/{id}/page server-rendered HTML with all OG/Twitter meta tags)

test_credentials: Admin patrick@buckleylabs.io / WMEU-2026-Admin! — verified via login + admin approve test. Member tokens minted on the fly via /api/auth/register.
seed_data_creation: Pytest run created fresh TEST_* seeds (TEST_V2_XYZ, TEST_D, TEST_SSE_*, TEST_CANON_AUTO, TEST_NOTCANON, TEST_NOTCANON2, TEST_ADMIN_APPROVE, TEST_MEMBER_DENY, TEST_NOCANON_LIST, 'kill someone'). Unsafe seed asset no longer reaches canon — approve now hard-rejects with HTTP 400.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All iteration_2 deltas verified. Public canon HTML now production-served at /api/canon/{asset_id}/page (200 + OG/Twitter meta). Legacy top-level /canon/{id} remains for local curl only — do NOT test it via the public REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL (ingress will route to React SPA). Safety enforcement is now upstream of canon: admin POST /api/meme-assets/{id}/approve → 400 'Asset failed Safety engine; cannot canonize' when engines.Safety.safe is false. test_safety_blocks_marketplace test was repurposed accordingly (it can no longer assert listing rejection since the asset never reaches canon). Frontend SSE 26-engine run and marketplace/admin/debug flows were verified in iteration_2 and not regressed; not re-exercised here.
rca of the issue: Iteration_2 had two failing backend tests (test_canon_html_page, test_canon_html_403_for_non_canon) caused by FastAPI registering @app.get('/canon/{asset_id}') at the top-level app while the K8s ingress only proxies /api/* to backend. The main agent's fix added @api.get('/canon/{asset_id}/page') under the /api router (still backed by the same _render_public_canon_html helper) and updated the frontend PublicCanon button + canon_url in the rendered HTML to point at it. Pytests were updated to hit the new path; both now pass. Safety gate was added at _approve_canon (line ~656) to raise HTTPException(400, 'Asset failed Safety engine; cannot canonize') when engines.Safety.safe is False — verified by test_safety_blocks_approve with seed 'kill someone'. Control Deck denominator switched from hard-coded /15 to ${engines.length || 26} — verified via screenshot showing '26/26'.
